notes: Direct HTTP (curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation) reached crateandbarrel.me without any block, consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's note that this SAP Commerce Cloud (hybris) storefront is a separate platform from the Akamai-protected US site. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Fetched the full site category tree from the unprotected /rest/v2/cab/catalogs endpoint (550+ nodes, XML) and full-text-searched it for best-seller/popular/favorite/trending terms, then cross-checked against homepage HTML (48 occurrences of 'best-sellers' embedded in nav/menu data, confirming prominent main-nav placement). Found a genuine top-level 'Best Sellers' node (/c/best-sellers) directly under 'Shop All' in main nav; it is a leaf category with no children (single undifferentiated listing). Its exact product count was pulled live from the site's own OCC REST API (api.crateandbarrel.me/rest/v2/cab/products/search?query=:relevance:allCategories:best-sellers), which the prior Home-Decor pass verified exhaustively (Wall Mirrors category: API pagination.totalResults exactly matched the unique product-code count and the site's own on-page counter) to be the identical data source the client-rendered PLP grid uses for its visible 'X Results' label (confirmed here too: the page bundle contains the same 'resultsLabel':'countResults' i18n wiring feeding off this API). Considered and EXCLUDED as non-Bestsellers: 'Best Value' (/c/best-value) - a pricing/value concept, not a popularity ranking; 'Popular Entertaining Collections' (/c/tabletop-bar-2/popular-entertaining-collections) and its 5 named children (Marin/Aspen/Mercer/Tour/Craft Tabletop Collections) - these are branded product-line collections, 'Popular' used as a marketing label for a set of design lines, not a best-selling/most-popular product ranking; 'Favorite Gifts' > 'Best Kids' Gifts' (16 products) and 'Best Baby Gifts' (33 products) under Crate & Kids > Gifts - a curated gift-guide-by-demographic branch ('gifts by age/recipient/price'), editorial curation of gift ideas rather than the site's own bestseller/top-selling merchandising concept, and structurally unrelated to (not an alias of) the genuine /c/best-sellers node. No Crate & Kids-specific 'Best Sellers' branch exists anywhere in the tree.

rows.evidence: api.crateandbarrel.me/rest/v2/cab/products/search?query=:relevance:allCategories:best-sellers -> <pagination><totalResults>430</totalResults></pagination>; this is the same OCC search API the client-rendered PLP grid consumes for its on-page results count (method verified exhaustively in the prior Home-Decor pass on this platform)
